record.rationale: Task6764KT in-progress browser weld ComboBox presentation for font/style controllers, currently connected to the style controller. The widget owns editable draft, nondispatching keyboard travel, explicit acceptance, accessible custom rows, actual DOM overlay geometry and composite focus. Native style-name lookup, document focus release and dispatch remain in SvxStyleBox controller. Overlay measures actual DOM geometry and avoids toolbar overflow clipping. Native platform/full popup parity and production font/style drawing remain unverified; no behavioral/default parity promotion. Task6764KT replaces the native-HTML font selector with the actual shared editable browser ComboBox. Direct picks and ordinary Enter release the owning Writer document/Calc grid before complete SvxFontItem acceptance; Tab accepts without explicit release, Escape restores the binding and sidebar Escape bubbles to its deck. Raw missing names are accepted without inventing installed rows. Font list enumeration refreshes retain an unchanged typed assignment through the common resetKey port; style option-owner changes still cancel stale drafts. Writer toolbar,Character panel focus entry and Calc workbench pass actual document focus owners. Glyph/cmap-dependent custom font row drawing,live preview/EndPreview owners,completion and full native platform behavior remain unfinished; no font/UI parity flag is promoted. Task6764KT connects native default-enabled font history with maximum five to actual Writer toolbar/sidebar and Calc controls. Recent and main duplicate names retain separate row identities for keyboard travel and a separator. Programmatic lookup uses the main-list row as native find_text does. Enter/direct pick update history after controller acceptance; Tab/travel do not. Refill and profile restore preserve GTK prepend order and tail-duplicate behavior (WRITER078/079). Actual pagehide/unmount persistence uses the common browser profile and retains per-widget histories. Focused strict100 and actual desktop/narrow Chromium cover this consumed contract. WYSIWYG glyph/cmap row rendering,completion and full platform behavior remain unfinished.
